@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Compared to her first novel, which was a bestseller, Chris' l______t novel barely sold any copies.
= latest
~詞義 latest（adj.）最新的
~原文 Compared to her first novel, which was a bestseller, Chris' latest novel barely sold any copies.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My friends and I enjoyed a l______y vacation in the countryside last winter.
= leisurely
~詞義 leisurely（adj.）悠閒的
~原文 My friends and I enjoyed a leisurely vacation in the countryside last winter.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Suddenly, the door b______ged shut, which scared everyone in the room.
= banged
~詞義 bang（v.）發出巨響
~原文 Suddenly, the door banged shut, which scared everyone in the room.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Mr. Brown is a c______r; his job is to make and repair wooden objects.
= carpenter
~詞義 carpenter（n.）木匠
~原文 Mr. Brown is a carpenter; his job is to make and repair wooden objects.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The queen waved to everybody from her c______e as it slowly made its way down the street.
= carriage
~詞義 carriage（n.）四輪馬車
~原文 The queen waved to everybody from her carriage as it slowly made its way down the street.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The mailman came this morning while I was out, so my neighbor received the ______ for me.
A: parcel
B: hallway
C: navy
D: ladder
= A
~詞義 parcel（n.）包裹
~原文 The mailman came this morning while I was out, so my neighbor received the parcel for me.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: You have to tighten the ______ of your shoes, or you may trip and fall down when you are walking.
A: rags
B: jars
C: baits
D: laces
= D
~詞義 lace（n.）鞋帶
~原文 You have to tighten the laces of your shoes, or you may trip and fall down when you are walking.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Some companies allow their employees to wear ______ clothes to work on Fridays.
A: icy
B: casual
C: magnetic
D: formal
= B
~詞義 casual（adj.）隨意的
~原文 Some companies allow their employees to wear casual clothes to work on Fridays.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: My father used to ______ on the horse races, but eventually, he quit because he had lost too much money.
A: cast
B: chop
C: lace
D: gamble
= D
~詞義 gamble（v.）賭博
~原文 My father used to gamble on the horse races, but eventually, he quit because he had lost too much money.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: David invited his old ______ from college to celebrate his birthday at a small restaurant.
A: pads
B: jaws
C: pals
D: oaks
= C
~詞義 pal（n.）好友
~原文 David invited his old pals from college to celebrate his birthday at a small restaurant.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: leisure
B: lately
C: hairdresser
D: comma
E: rag
F: maid

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: During the summer break, Lily finally had time to read novels and paint at her ______.
= A
~詞義 leisure（n.）有空時(at one's leisure)
~原文 During the summer break, Lily finally had time to read novels and paint at her leisure.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Molly wiped her shoes with an old ______ and then threw it away.
= E
~詞義 rag（n.）破布;舊布
~原文 Molly wiped her shoes with an old rag and then threw it away.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: I never go to a ______. In fact, I cut my hair by myself.
= C
~詞義 hairdresser（n.）美髮師
~原文 I never go to a hairdresser. In fact, I cut my hair by myself.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sometimes a ______ can totally change the meaning of a sentence.
= D
~詞義 comma（n.）逗點
~原文 Sometimes a comma can totally change the meaning of a sentence.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______, many students have become addicted to live streaming apps.
= B
~詞義 lately（adv.）最近
~原文 Lately, many students have become addicted to live streaming apps.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: chop
B: icy
C: magnetic
D: crew
E: barn
F: cast

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Every ______ member played an important role in ensuring the ship's safe journey across the ocean.
= D
~詞義 crew（n.）(船上的)全體人員
~原文 Every crew member played an important role in ensuring the ship's safe journey across the ocean.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The little boy ______ a stone into the lake, smiling as circles spread across the calm surface.
= F
~詞義 cast（v.）投擲
~原文 The little boy cast a stone into the lake, smiling as circles spread across the calm surface.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The children often use ______ letters to spell words on the fridge.
= C
~詞義 magnetic（adj.）磁鐵的
~原文 The children often use magnetic letters to spell words on the fridge.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: If you ______ the wood into two pieces, it will be easier for us to carry it.
= A
~詞義 chop（v.）砍;劈
~原文 If you chop the wood into two pieces, it will be easier for us to carry it.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The farmer raised many animals, such as ducks and chickens, in his ______.
= E
~詞義 barn（n.）穀倉
~原文 The farmer raised many animals, such as ducks and chickens, in his barn.
